title: a new TODO / FIXME / HACK / XXX comment
how: the upper-case markers in comments (the word todo as data or a status is not one)

explain.what: A new comment has a TODO, FIXME, HACK or XXX marker.
explain.why: A marker in the code is a task that no list tracks. It stays in the code long after anyone remembers it.
explain.fix: Do the work now, or record it (`norn road add` or a record) and delete the marker.
